    The Dallas Mavericks vs. Los Angeles Lakers game on April 5, 2026, can be watched on
    NBC and streamed on Peacock or Amazon Prime Video at 6:30 p.m. CST (7:30 p.m. ET). Local viewers in Dallas can watch on WFAA Ch. 8 or KFAA Ch. 29, while local Lakers fans can watch on Spectrum SportsNet. 
    Where to Watch & Stream (April 5, 2026) 
    • National TV: NBC
    • Streaming: Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, NBA League Pass (out-of-market)
    • Local Market (Dallas): WFAA Ch. 8 or KFAA Ch. 29
    • Local Market (Lakers): Spectrum SportsNet
    • Radio: KEGL 97.1 FM The Eagle (Dallas) 
    For fans outside the US, the game is also available on Prime Video. If you are traveling, using a VPN might be necessary to access your local streaming service, as Prime Video can have regional restrictions.
